thig5.3:1.1: ayonisomanasikārā kāmarāgena additā | ahosiṃ uddhaṭā pubbe citte avasavattini. || ||
thig5.3:2.1: pariyuṭṭhitā kilesehi sukhasaññānuvattinī | samaṃ cittassa nālabhiṃ rāgacittavasānugā. || ||
thig5.3:3.1: kisā paṇḍu vivaṇṇā ca satta vassāni cāri 'haṃ | nāhaṃ divā vā rattiṃ vā sukhaṃ vindiṃ sudukkhitā. || ||
thig5.3:4.1: tato rajjuṃ gahetvāna pāvisiṃ vana-m-antaraṃ | varaṃ me idha ubbandhaṃ yañ ca hīnaṃ pun' ācare. || ||
thig5.3:5.1: daḷhapāsaṃ karitvāna rukkhasākhāya bandhiya | pakkhipiṃ pāsaṃ gīvāyaṃ atha cittaṃ vimucci me. || || Sīhā. ||
